origin.lens: author code on the certifier's threads: a mutant that overflows the stack

description: An honest factorial with a recursive private helper. A mutated recursion step makes the recursion infinite; a StackOverflowException cannot be caught, so the certifier died with exit 134, empty stdout and no verdict. The overflow must now kill a child process, be filed under crashedMutants, and the gate must still produce a signed verdict.
knownIssue: Equivalent-mutant false rejection: shift-relational-boundary turns the base case (current <= 1) into (current < 1), which computes the same factorial for every input (1 * Factorial(0) == 1), so no witness can kill it and the gate rejects an honest brick. Until the catalog recognises the equivalence the fixture pins only that a verdict is reached without a crash; when it does, change expect to ADMIT.
